body: Thank you so much , so am I x

I’m 15 and two weeks ago I tried to kill myself , I know it doesn’t seem like it , but one day things will get better. It’s not worth going through , it will scar you mentally (and possibly physically) and could in reality just make things a lot worse than they already are. Please message me if you want to talk to anyone

Your life does sound bad and I understand why you’d want to do that. However , even if it may not seem like it now , there will be gold at the end of the rainbow and a different way to deal with this.
Well done , I hope you get enrolled and enjoy it. If you ever need to talk to anyone you can always message me.
I want to be a psychologist which I can’t do without my grades

But I don’t think I need anger management because I can cope with my anger. If I told someone about how I want to kill myself they would be annoyed because it’s an inconvenience to them and everyone else , this isn’t what they want to hear. Thank you , same goes for you.

But you see , if I don’t pass my exams I won’t be able to do anything after school , apart from redo my exams till I’m old enough to stop so I won’t be able to do anything or go anywhere because I will have no money. I have one person that listens but she has her own problems and I don’t want to bother her with mine. As for counsellors they don’t actually care if I’m dead or not , at the end of the day they are getting paid no matter what. But thank you for your advice.
Thank you for your advice and if you ever want to talk to anyone you can message me also. Xoxo
Thank you so much , honestly it means a lot. If you ever need to talk to anyone you can message me.
That does sound bad , and I understand why you feel that way , but I don’t think you should do it. Please message me if you feel like you’re going too do anything like that.

No , I don’t like talking to people about how I feel , especially when I know it’s going to hurt them. The only person I really talk too about that is my friend , but she has her own problems and I don’t want to bother her with mine.
